samples.xml_description: Implement a parallel to serial converter with MSB to LSB order. Clock signal. Active-low reset. 4-bit parallel input. Valid signal for serial output. Serial output. State 0 description. State 1 description. State 2 description. State 3 description. Output dout is the most significant bit of the data register. When cnt is 3 (the last bit), update the data register with the parallel input d. Reset the cnt to 0. Set the valid signal to 1. Otherwise, increment the cnt by 1. Set the valid signal to 0. Shift the data register left by 1. The most significant bit of data is shifted to the least significant bit. The cnt register is incremented on each clock cycle. Reset the cnt register when rst_n is high.
